name: agentsec held-out detection benchmark
description: Fresh, author-written, synthetic fixtures written AFTER the issue #7–#11 rule changes were locked. They were not used to tune those rules. Same five tools as the original corpus, new wording and (for evasions) different obfuscation. Every credential is fake. This is not a real-world attack corpus.
positive_definition: A sample is counted as flagged when the assigned tool reports at least one finding with severity low, medium, high, or critical. Info-level inventory rules (for example SF12, FL10) are ignored.
